snippet.title: Galactic Economy - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Can you dominate the galaxy through strategy and smart decisions?

Galactic Economy is a sci-fi strategy board game where you manage resources, expand your influence, and outplay your rivals across the stars.

Build your empire, react to crises, and shape the future of an interstellar economy.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2286230/Galactic_Economy/

🌌 About the Game

🎲 Strategic Board Gameplay
• Roll dice and move across galactic sectors
• Acquire stations and expand your influence

📈 Build Your Empire
• Invest in trade routes and generate income
• Upgrade ships and strengthen your economy

🤖 Solo and Multiplayer
• Play alone or compete against friends
• Face AI or real players in strategic matches

🔁 High Replayability
• Every match offers new events and outcomes
• Adapt your strategy to changing conditions

🧠 Multiple Playstyles
• Expand aggressively or build steady income
• Choose the path that leads you to dominance

🚀 A Modern Board Game Experience
• Classic mechanics with digital enhancements
• Easy to learn, challenging to master
